decisions.decision: Cryptographically verified session as sole guest authority
decisions.rationale: Client-supplied x-session-id header and req.ip are spoofable and violate cross-guest isolation. Unverified guests use local_only storage in browser localStorage.

decisions.decision: PostgreSQL transaction-scoped advisory locks with hashtext(announcements:userId)
decisions.rationale: Prevents read-modify-write lost updates during concurrent requests while isolating lock scopes per user with zero cross-account contention.

decisions.decision: Fail-closed HTTP 503 PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE on database exception
decisions.rationale: Eliminated silent in-memory fallback on database errors to prevent masking outages and returning false 200 HTTP successes.

decisions.decision: Preserve existing memory_records table with 0 database schema migrations
decisions.rationale: Maintains zero DDL change invariant and preserves instant rollback capability.
